The '''2020 Minnesota League Tournament 2''' was announced for 7 March 2020 at Dreamers Vault in South Saint Paul, Minnesota. [[Mark Walseth]] organized two events that afternoon. A player could enter one event, not both. Each winner was to receive a glass trophy.<ref name="mnl2">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=74643 2019 - 2020 MN League Tournament (#2)], forum.starwarsccg.org (13–25 February 2020).</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Dreamers Vault, 207 13th Ave S, South Saint Paul, Minnesota<ref name="mnl2" />
* '''Date:''' 7 March 2020<ref name="mnl2" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Mark Walseth]]<ref name="mnl2" />
* '''Cost:''' $10, free to a new player or a player from outside the Bespin region<ref name="mnl2" />
* '''Open event:''' 4 constructed games, with an optional final<ref name="mnl2" />
* '''Restricted event:''' 4 constructed games and no final. The card pool was Premiere through Special Edition. Enhanced Jabba's Palace, Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck, Cloud City and Enhanced Cloud City premiums were allowed. Death Star II, Endor, Episode I, virtual cards, Reflections II and Reflections III were not. Current errata applied<ref name="mnl2" />
